Raphinha Gets A Perfect 10 | Barcelona Players Rated In Dominant Win Vs Racing Santander

By
Abhinab Ghosh
-
September 16, 2026
Facebook
X
Pinterest
WhatsApp
Copy URL
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 2:55
    Instaread

    Barcelona entertained Racing Santander at the Nou Camp earlier tonight as they hoped to secure a win at home in La Liga. The Catalan club made a bright start to the contest and got their noses ahead in the eighth minute when Joao Cancelo got his name on the scoresheet. Raphinha doubled his team’s advantage from the penalty spot in the 25th minute. However, the visitors got a goal back thanks to Maguette Gueye’s effort just five minutes later. Asier Villalibre scored an unfortunate own goal in the 36th minute before Raphinha put Barca 4-1 ahead in the 42nd minute. Hansi Flick’s men were leading 4-1 at the half-time interval.

    Yassir Zabiri scored Racing’s second goal in the 65th minute. However, Raphina completed his hat-trick from the penalty spot a couple of minutes later. Gabriel Jesus scored his side’s sixth goal in the 79th minute before Lamine Yamal joined in on the goal-scoring act late in the game. The match ended with Barcelona securing a dominant 7-2 win at the Nou Camp.

    Let’s take a look at how each Barcelona player fared during the clash against Racing Santander.

    GK: Joan Garcia – 6/10

    He was mostly solid in the first half and was replaced at half-time.

    RB: Eric Garcia – 6.5/10

    Garcia earned possession back once and made one good chance going forward.

    CB: Andreas Christensen – 6.5/10

    He made one crucial interception inside his half and was tidy with his passing.

    CB: Gerard Martin – 7.5/10

    Martin gave a good account of himself on the defensive end of the pitch.

    LB: Joao Cancelo – 7.5/10

    He was a positive influence on both halves and managed to score the opener in the eighth minute.

    CM: Pedri – 7/10

    Pedri engineered a handful of inviting chances for others around him during his time on the field.

    CM: Rodri – 7/10

    He anchored the midfield well and made two decent chances in the final third.

    CM: Dani Olmo – 8/10

    Olmo was a constant menace in and around the opponent’s penalty area and has an assist to show for his efforts.

    RW: Lamine Yamal – 9.5/10

    He caused all sorts of chaos in the final third and managed to score one and create two goals during the game.

    ST: Raphinha – 10/10

    The Brazilian scored a hat-trick to help Barcelona secure a dominant win tonight.

    LW: Karim Adeyemi – 9.5/10

    He caused a lot of problems for his marker and ended the game with an assist to his name.

    Substitutes:

    GK: Wojciech Szczesny – 5/10

    He made a costly error at the back.

    CM: Gavi – 6.5/10

    Gavi made one key chance in the final third.

    CM: Marc Bernal – 6/10

    He was lively on the ball.

    ST: Gabriel Jesus – 7/10

    Jesus did well to score after coming off the bench.

    LB: Alejandro Balde – 6.5/10

    He made one good chance going forward.
